items.short_description: Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the…
items.description:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
Simple Rules, Deep Strategy

The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

Key Features
• Pure & Immersive Experience
• Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
• Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.

Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards. Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines? Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. On the vast continent of Idyll, you'll encounter countless unique creatures known as Aniimo. Twine with them and experience the beauty of this world from a completely new perspective and with new abilities.
You can also travel to a metropolis floating in the sky, where you'll meet other Pathfinders, share stories, and engage in thrilling competitive battles. Choose your Aniimo and embark on an epic journey - one full of exploration, discovery, and adventure!

Seize every chance to capture and collect Aniimo to your heart's desire! 

When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

Twine with Aniimo to feel the world like they do

On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

Jump into the adventure and enjoy exploring an expansive open world

The continent of Idyll is expansive and alive with beauty and the perfect setting to capture, to Twine, to find answers and for the Aniimo to reach their full potential. Challenge, race, discover... immersive exploration ensures every step of the journey is engaging. Whether you're gliding, diving, burrowing... you can step foot anywhere.

Join exciting real-time challenges with Aniimo

In the vast world of Aniimo, every real-time challenge is full of unknowns and surprises. The PVEVP mode "Egg Heist" allows you to join a 3-player team anytime to engage in real-time searches and battles in the Lost Isles.
Whether you're solo, multiplayer, adventuring, battling, or simply looking to quickly become stronger, here, every challenge is real and instantaneous!

Enjoying camping and roadtrips with your friends

Each Pathfinder now owns a personal RV on the vast continent of Idyll, parked at a campsite in this open world, where they can meet and interact with other players. When you return to Homeland with your RV, you can plant crops, build decorations, and freely arrange your space with Aniimo to transform the entire Homeland into a warm, fun, and interactive immersive paradise.

items.description:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

- One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
- Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
- No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
- Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
- Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals, fruit, food, flowers, nature, festivals, toys, rockets, castles, and plenty more surprises. Every puzzle you finish adds another piece of pixel art to your collection, so there's always one more picture waiting to be uncovered.

With adorable ants, satisfying animations, soothing music, and no time pressure, Colony Flow is easy to pick up and gentle to play — the kind of game that fits into a coffee break, a commute, or a quiet evening on the couch. But clearing every level will take some clever planning.

Tap the right boxes, guide your ants, clear the blocks, and uncover beautiful pixel art. Your colony is waiting!
